pictures.name: waymarked_ridge_path
pictures.scene: a hill path climbing a bare ridge with small cairns of piled stone set along it to mark the way, the nearest cairn lit warm and hard low in the frame, the ridge and sky above them pale and open

pictures.name: long_path_climbing_to_the_skyline
pictures.scene: a track running steadily uphill and holding its line all the way to a distant skyline, the near ground lit warm and gold at the bottom of the frame, the long slope above it soft and pale and quiet

pictures.name: light_reaching_into_a_deep_room
pictures.scene: one broad shaft of daylight reaching in through a doorway and lighting the floor of a deep room, the lit paving warm and gold at the bottom of the frame, the far walls above it dim and plain and calm

pictures.name: deep_worn_groove_in_a_doorstep
pictures.scene: a stone doorstep hollowed into a smooth deep groove by long constant use, the worn stone lit warm and hard at the bottom of the frame, the doorway above it dim and quiet and standing open

pictures.name: stone_marker_at_a_path_junction
pictures.scene: one upright stone set plainly where two paths meet on open ground, the marker and the near track lit warm and clear at the bottom of the frame, the country and sky above them pale and wide and still

pictures.name: sunlit_clearing_among_trees
pictures.scene: a round open clearing full of warm sunlight in the middle of a dim wood, the lit grass gold along the bottom of the frame, the trees around and above it deep and green and quietly shaded

pictures.name: empty_scale_pans_on_a_bench
pictures.scene: a small bronze balance standing on a bench with both its pans quite empty and at rest, the pans lit warm and hard at the bottom of the frame, the wall above them dim and rough and holding nothing

pictures.name: shards_of_broken_pottery_swept_aside
pictures.scene: a heap of broken pottery pieces swept into a corner and left there, the nearest shards lit hard and low at the bottom of the frame, the swept floor and wall above them plain and dim and empty

pictures.name: deep_set_post_in_firm_ground
pictures.scene: a squared timber post driven deep and packed tight into firm earth and standing perfectly upright, its base lit warm and hard at the bottom of the frame, the post rising above it plain and dark

pictures.name: clean_swept_threshold_in_sunlight
pictures.scene: a doorway threshold swept quite clean and lying in clear morning sunlight, the stone lit warm and bright at the bottom of the frame, the doorway and wall above it plain and pale and untroubled

pictures.name: young_shoot_breaking_dry_soil
pictures.scene: one bright green shoot pushing up through hard dry cracked soil, the shoot and the broken crust lit warm and clear at the bottom of the frame, the dry ground beyond it dull and pale and flat

lines.text: Teach me, O LORD, the way of Your statutes,
and I will keep them to the end.
Give me understanding that I may obey Your law,
and follow it with all my heart.
Direct me in the path of Your commandments,
Turn my heart to Your testimonies
Turn my eyes away from worthless things;
Establish Your word to Your servant,
Turn away the disgrace I dread,
How I long for Your precepts!
